policy.title: GPU policy
items: Every card has a standing owner (see Card assignment). Use your own cards without booking.
To use someone else's card, the owner must have switched on Can share, and you must book it here first with the exact cards and dates.
Run only on the cards you own or booked: set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES accordingly.
Release a booking as soon as you are done so others can use the cards.
Near a deadline, ask in the lab chat; owners are encouraged to share or lend their cards.

penalty.title: Penalties
items: A job running on a card you neither own nor booked may be killed without notice.
Booked cards left idle for more than 24 hours: the booking is cancelled by an admin.
Repeated violations: booking privileges suspended for one week.

chat.label: WeChat group
chat.emphasis: Communicate first to get more GPU resources.
